movie.title: Holy Days
movie.overview: When young Brian discovers plans to close a convent of delightfully eccentric nuns, he sets off with them on a wild road trip across New Zealand to save their home.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a small-town boy learns his beloved local convent is facing closure, he embarks on an unforgettable road trip across New Zealand with a group of eccentric nuns to save their sanctuary.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Young Brian is devastated to learn that the local convent, home to a quirky community of warmhearted nuns, is scheduled to be closed down forever. Refusing to accept this fate, he rallies the sisters to embark on a spirited cross-country journey across New Zealand's scenic landscape. Along the road, they face hilarious obstacles, forge deep bonds, and discover that faith and family can be found in the most unexpected places. Together, their wild adventure becomes a heartwarming quest to preserve their home and community.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a charming New Zealand town, young Brian forms an unlikely and deep connection with the delightfully eccentric nuns living at the local convent. His world is turned upside down when he uncovers plans by church authorities to shut down the convent and relocate the sisters. Unwilling to stand by and watch his friends lose their sanctuary, Brian hatches a bold plan to help them fight back. Together, Brian and the spirited nuns set out on a hilarious, unpredictable road trip across the breathtaking New Zealand countryside to appeal the decision. Driving through vibrant towns and rugged landscapes, the mismatched group encounters mechanical breakdowns, quirky locals, and unexpected personal challenges. As they navigate the trial and errors of the open road, the sisters show surprising resourcefulness and joy, inspiring Brian to grow in confidence. Each stop along their journey brings new comedic misadventures alongside poignant moments of self-discovery and shared faith. Ultimately, their determination and unwavering bond spark a community-wide movement to protect what matters most. The epic voyage transforms everyone involved, proving that home isn't just a building, but the love that holds a community together.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Holy Days is an uplifting adventure comedy-drama set against the stunning backdrops of New Zealand. The story centers on Brian, a young boy with a big heart, who uncovers a plan to permanently close the convent that houses his dearest friends—a group of wonderfully unconventional and free-spirited nuns. Determined to save the place that brings so much joy to their community, Brian joins forces with the sisters as they take to the open road in a desperate attempt to rescue their home. As they journey across the country, the group faces a series of humorous misadventures, heartfelt encounters, and personal revelations. Combining laugh-out-loud comedy with poignant dramatic moments, Holy Days explores timeless themes of friendship, belonging, faith, and the power of fighting for the place you call home.

story_structure.climax: The road trip reaches a critical junction where the group must make a stand and confront the impending threat to their home before time runs out.

story_structure.resolution: The journey concludes as the impact of their shared adventure secures the sisters' future and brings lasting clarity and growth to young Brian.
story_structure.introduction: Young Brian develops a relationship with a group of delightfully eccentric nuns residing in a close-knit New Zealand convent.
story_structure.risingAction: Refusing to accept the shutdown, Brian joins forces with the sisters to embark on a wild road trip across New Zealand, navigating unpredictable obstacles, humorous misadventures, and deepening bonds along the way.
